question: After the user's 9.24 regime correction, does a cash-start bull account using the already frozen strong-stock undercut/reclaim entry and volatility trail support a useful net payoff and board-relative return? Does the unchanged total-turnover gate add value?

scope.primary: User-designated bull period; no inherited pre-split position or cash loss

signals.source: Exact original immediate.signals.json files bound by reclaim-volatility-trail-v1; retain rows in the registered dates, all original IDs, ranks, order and gaps. Not a previously filled/active-event subset.
signals.liquid: Original opportunities on dates when the batch50 archived TDX Shanghai+Shenzhen total-turnover proxy at T >=1e12 CNY and mean(T-4..T) >= mean(T-20..T-1). Require 21 exact calendar observations. Same constants and source as batch50; no missingness fill, new ranking, backfill, delayed entry or fitted threshold.
signals.clock: T close decision, one immediate next-source-session opening attempt; preserve T+1 sale lock, cash, lots and price/capacity gates. The date split selects the research scope, not a claimed advance bull-market detector.

exitAndCapital.source: Exact original VolatilityTrailAccount and reclaim-volatility-trail-v1 2024-2025 volatilityTrail config; only change startDate to2024-09-24.
exitAndCapital.capital: Each of six independently executed accounts starts with500000 CNY, at most5 holdings and20percent entry budget. No source result is reused as a new account.
exitAndCapital.exit: Keep5percent initial close stop; no fixed percent trail, profit cap or holding deadline. Existing floor is max(previous floor, closePeak*(1-3*prior20 mean normalized true range)), evaluated using21 exact slots strictly before the held close. The dimensionless risk-entry floor only tightens.
exitAndCapital.cost: Original LegacyFeePolicy and10bps each-side slippage, all configured costs unchanged. A close stop is not a realized-loss ceiling.

primary: Fully closed net mean win percent / absolute net mean loss percent
Continuous account net return and drawdown
Same-date board price-index excess percentage points
Closed sample size, holding time, exposure, tails, concentration and open PnL
evaluation.subperiods: 2024Q4 and2025 inside the continuous bull account; no equity reset. Treat sparse-year exits and existing-position gains explicitly.
evaluation.screens: Reuse batch50 proposed R>=3, PF>=1.5, mean loss magnitude<=5percent, maxDD<=20percent and>=30closed episodes as diagnostics. Numerical requirements are not human-confirmed, and a screen pass does not certify the goal.
evaluation.benchmarks: Same archived local sh000300, sz399006 and sh000688 price-index snapshots as batch50. Same start/end close, no dividend or benchmark transaction costs; not a risk-adjusted alpha estimate.

validation: Prior source and original schedule hashes; original20 volatility adapter unit tests plus frozen entry/account/fee tests before accounts. Independent direct-window liquidity schedule replay. Reuse only the hash-pinned pure independent every-held-day volatility-risk oracle; independently recompute trade/curve outcomes, reconcile saved account/fee/position bridges, verify T+1 and no same-close exits.
limits: All2022-2025 history is repeatedly inspected development. Prior full-period results and later episode-only diagnostics informed this decision; this is not independent holdout evidence.
No result-based board selection: all three boards and both admission policies must be retained.

TDX turnover is a broad market proxy, not a certified official all-A total. Official SSE420 and SZSE75 receipts were available for batch50 checks; the slow SZSE resume also stopped at its first failure. Complete official replication remains pending.

Raw unadjusted prices, surviving stock cohorts, incomplete dated identity/ST/rights and unverified opening auction capacity remain material. No stable-profit, market-order, deployment or publication claim.
